# VoiceBlueprint Pro — Support

VoiceBlueprint Pro is an **independent DevTunaSoft open-source project**. The original project's support team, Discord server, social accounts, website, email addresses, paid plans and payment accounts **do not support this application**.

## Official project channels

- [VoiceBlueprint Pro repository](https://github.com/DevTunaSoft/VoiceBlueprint-Pro) — source, releases, README and development status
- [Issues](https://github.com/DevTunaSoft/VoiceBlueprint-Pro/issues) — bugs and feature proposals **once repository Issues are enabled**
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md) — how to report vulnerabilities privately; do not publish exploit details in an issue
- [User manual](../docs/user-guide/README.md) — setup, workflows and troubleshooting

There is currently **no verified direct support email, Discord community, sponsorship checkout or commercial support offering** for VoiceBlueprint Pro. Do not send money, personal information or security reports to accounts associated with the original project.

## Troubleshooting

Use the in-app self-check and diagnostic bundle when available. Remove tokens, account information, model access credentials and private audio before sharing a report. Preserve user data during troubleshooting; see the [uninstall guide](../docs/install/uninstall.md) before deleting files.

## Response expectations

This project is maintained on a best-effort basis. No fixed response time, paid support SLA, or guaranteed release schedule is promised. The presence of a GitHub workflow or automated test is not proof of a production-ready build.
